cards.headline: Artificial intelligence applications in biofilm research

source.title: Artificial intelligence applications in biofilm research: computational approaches for biofilm analysis and antimicrobial prediction.
source.excerpt: Overall, this review shows how AI could help improve the accuracy, integration, and tailoring of biofilm research and antimicrobial management.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence for Early Cancer Detection in Nigeria

source.title: Artificial Intelligence for Early Cancer Detection in Nigeria: A Contextual Narrative Review of Applications, Barriers, and Implementation Pathways.
source.excerpt: AI offers transformative potential for early cancer detection in Nigeria, but success requires staged implementation: short-term pilots in teaching hospitals, medium-term development of national AI guidelines and workforce training, and long-term integration into cancer control plans.

cards.headline: Totenhütte von Benzingerode

source.title: Totenhütte von Benzingerode
source.excerpt: Die Totenhütte von Benzingerode ist ein bei archäologischen Untersuchungen im Nordosten von Benzingerode im nördlichen Harz entdecktes Gemeinschaftsgrab, das anhand der geborgenen Funde der jungsteinzeitlichen Bernburger Kultur zugeordnet werden kann.

cards.headline: Effectiveness of the flipped classroom in medical education

source.title: Effectiveness of the flipped classroom in medical education: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Flipped classrooms were associated with improved outcomes in medical education, with larger effects in residents. Given high heterogeneity and limited evidence in some domains, benefits appear context dependent. Implementation should be tailored, and future studies should define mechanisms and optimal conditions.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Diabetes Mellitus Management

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Diabetes Mellitus Management: A Narrative Review of Advances, Architectures, and Translational Challenges.
source.excerpt: AI has the potential to transform DM care through more precise forecasting, earlier complication detection, and individualized treatment.

cards.headline: Mars (Planet)

source.title: Mars (Planet)
source.excerpt: Der Mars ist, von der Sonne aus gezählt, der vierte Planet im Sonnensystem und der äußere Nachbar der Erde. Er zählt zu den erdähnlichen (terrestrischen) Planeten.

cards.headline: AI-driven biosensing technology for early disease detection: A comprehensive review

source.title: AI-driven biosensing technology for early disease detection: A comprehensive review.
source.publisher: Technology and health care : official journal of the European Society for Engineering and Medicine
source.excerpt: Nevertheless, there are still challenges such as lack of data, generalization of models, regulatory authorization, and moral issues.

cards.headline: Synergizing New Approach Methodologies and Artificial Intelligence

source.title: Synergizing New Approach Methodologies and Artificial Intelligence: Charting the Paradigm Shift Toward Next-Generation Chemical Risk Assessment.
source.excerpt: Open data infrastructure, standardized benchmarking, and harmonized validation frameworks will be essential to realize the full potential of this approach.

cards.headline: Petra Rossner

source.title: Petra Rossner
source.excerpt: Petra Rossner ist eine ehemalige deutsche Radrennfahrerin. Nach ihrer Zeit als Aktive nach Ende der Saison 2004 wurde sie Trainerin des Team Columbia.

cards.headline: Levosimendan vs. Intra-Aortic Balloon Pump in Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting

source.title: Levosimendan vs. Intra-Aortic Balloon Pump in Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting: A Meta-Analysis.
source.excerpt: Levosimendan may improve recovery and hemodynamic outcomes in high-risk CABG patients compared to IABP but may be associated with a higher, though non-significant, risk of mediastinitis. Further high-quality studies are warranted.

cards.headline: Synthetic artificial intelligence in cardiology

source.title: Synthetic artificial intelligence in cardiology: from generative models to clinical applications.
source.excerpt: As investment grows and methods mature, cardiologists must shape this evolution-not as passive adopters, but as active drivers. This review invites them to take the wheel.

cards.headline: Clinical utility of LLMs in otology and neurotology: a systematic review and meta-analysis

source.title: Clinical utility of LLMs in otology and neurotology: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.publisher: European archives of oto-rhino-laryngology : official journal of the European Federation of Oto-Rhino-Laryngological Societies (EUFOS) : affiliated with the German Society for Oto-Rhino-Laryngology - Head and Neck Surgery
source.excerpt: GPT-based LLMs show promise for patient education and knowledge-based tasks in otology and neurotology. However, their limited performance in diagnostic and therapeutic decision-making supports their use as adjuncts rather than replacements for clinician judgment.

cards.headline: Acidic cannabinoids in brain disorders

source.title: Acidic cannabinoids in brain disorders: Neurobiological mechanisms, preclinical evidence, and translational challenges.
source.excerpt: Overall, acidic cannabinoids emerge as promising but still underexplored multitarget compounds with potential relevance for the treatment of brain disorders.

cards.headline: Prevalence of cognitive frailty in older adults with stroke in China

source.title: Prevalence of cognitive frailty in older adults with stroke in China: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: Early identification and evidence-based interventions targeting CF in this population may be crucial to mitigating adverse health outcomes pending further validation.

cards.headline: eine der anderen Nachkommenschaft. Und Allah ist Allhörend und Allwissend.

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:34
source.excerpt: هؤلاء الأنبياء والرسل سلسلة طُهْر متواصلة في الإخلاص لله وتوحيده والعمل بوحيه. والله سميع لأقوال عباده، عليم بأفعالهم، وسيجازيهم على ذلك.

cards.arabic: ذُرِّيَّةًۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنۢ بَعْضٍ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
cards.translation: eine der anderen Nachkommenschaft. Und Allah ist Allhörend und Allwissend.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Chosen Ones Among the People of the Earth: Allah states that He has chosen these households over the people of the earth. For instance, Allah chose Adam, created him with His Hand and blew life into him.

cards.headline: Als ’Imrans Frau sagte: „Mein Herr, ich gelobe Dir, was in meinem Mutterleib ist …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:35
source.excerpt: اذكر -أيها الرسول- ما كان من أمر مريم وأمها وابنها عيسى عليه السلام; لتردَّ بذلك على من ادعوا أُلوهية عيسى أو بنوَّته لله سبحانه، إذ قالت امرأة عمران حين حملت: يا ربِّ إني جعلت لك ما في بطني خالصا لك، لخدمة «بيت المقدس» ، فتقبَّل مني; إنك أنت وحدك السميع لدعائي، العليم بنيتي.

cards.arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
cards.translation: Als ’Imrans Frau sagte: „Mein Herr, ich gelobe Dir, was in meinem Mutterleib ist, für Deinen Dienst freigestellt. So nimm (es) von mir an! Du bist ja der Allhörende und Allwissende.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Story of Maryam's Birth: The wife of `Imran mentioned here is the mother of Maryam, and her name is Hannah bint Faqudh. Muhammad bin Ishaq mentioned that Hannah could not have children and that one day, she saw a bird feeding its chick.

cards.headline: AI-Driven Predictive Models of Early Recurrence of HCC After Surgical Resection

source.title: AI-Driven Predictive Models of Early Recurrence of HCC After Surgical Resection: A Systematic Review.
source.excerpt: AI-driven models show potential to predict early recurrence of HCC after curative-intent resection. Nevertheless, evidence remains limited by methodological heterogeneity and restricted geographical diversity, while clinical utility remains inconsistently evaluated, and no model has yet been generalized in clinical practice.

cards.headline: Nanomaterial-enhanced biosensors for traumatic brain injury biomarker detection

source.title: Nanomaterial-enhanced biosensors for traumatic brain injury biomarker detection: a review of analytical performance, machine learning integration, clinical validation, and point-of-care translation.
source.excerpt: Future progress will depend on robust clinical validation, standardized performance assessment, scalable manufacturing, and regulatory alignment to support the translation of TBI biosensors into routine point-of-care practice.

cards.headline: Deep Learning and Cardiovascular Diseases: An Updated Narrative Review

source.title: Deep Learning and Cardiovascular Diseases: An Updated Narrative Review.
source.excerpt: AI and DL have transformative potential in cardiology, offering fast, accurate, and scalable diagnostic tools. The integration of multimodal data, the validation of algorithms in prospective studies, and ensuring the transparency of models are key.

cards.headline: Bridging the vaccine gap

source.title: Bridging the vaccine gap: Scientific and technological advances for diseases lacking effective vaccines.
source.excerpt: Equitable access frameworks and regulatory harmonisation across LMICs remain critical unresolved challenges.

cards.headline: Assessment and implementation of AI-enabled digital health technologies in hospitals

source.title: Assessment and implementation of AI-enabled digital health technologies in hospitals: a review and qualitative document analysis of HTA reports and guidance documents.
source.excerpt: The European Network for HTA Core Model, supplemented with AI-specific guidance, provides a practical evaluation toolkit for hospitals.

cards.headline: Applications of Federated Large Language Model for Adverse Drug Reactions Prediction

source.title: Applications of Federated Large Language Model for Adverse Drug Reactions Prediction: Scoping Review.
source.excerpt: Given the recent emergence of LLM, the integration of FL and LLM for ADR prediction remains in its early stage, with limited documented use cases. This review explored the potential applications and highlighted the advancements of federated learning with large language models in health care research, particularly in ADR prediction.

cards.headline: Machine Learning for Comparative Antidepressant Selection in Major Depressive Disorder

source.title: Machine Learning for Comparative Antidepressant Selection in Major Depressive Disorder: Systematic Review.
source.excerpt: ML for comparative antidepressant selection remains in an early stage of development. Only 1 study implemented a unified framework directly supporting patient-level treatment ranking. Key barriers to clinical translation include insufficient distinction between prognostic and predictive markers, limited cross-trial validation, near-absent calibration reporting, and absent explainability.

cards.headline: Deep Learning Image Processing Models in Dermatopathology

source.title: Deep Learning Image Processing Models in Dermatopathology.
source.excerpt: Further, we discuss potential future research directions and emphasize the need for diverse, prospectively curated datasets, explainability frameworks for trust in AI, and rigorous compliance to Good Machine-Learning-Practice (GMLP) to achieve safe and scalable deep learning dermatopathology models that can fully integrate into clinical workflows.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence in Anterior Chamber Evaluation

source.title: Artificial Intelligence in Anterior Chamber Evaluation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
source.excerpt: DLA applied to AS-OCT has excellent sensitivity and specificity in the identification of angle closure. This technology may be a valuable resource in the screening of populations without access to experienced ophthalmologists who perform gonioscopy.

cards.headline: Engineering smart liposomes to combat antimicrobial resistance

source.title: Engineering smart liposomes to combat antimicrobial resistance: from mechanistic design to clinical translation.
source.excerpt: Successful clinical translation will depend on formulation- and infection-specific evidence, clinically relevant preclinical models, controlled and scalable manufacturing, and appropriate regulatory frameworks, while artificial intelligence, digital-twin, and precision-medicine approaches are best viewed as decision-support tools that complement experimental and clinical validation.

cards.headline: The hypothalamic-neurohypophyseal system in preeclampsia

source.title: The hypothalamic-neurohypophyseal system in preeclampsia: a systematic review with a subgroup meta-analysis of copeptin levels worldwide.
source.excerpt: It is essential to improve the early detection of this condition by understanding how genetic and geographic factors influence PE causes.

cards.headline: Biological Variability and Biomedical Innovation in Personalized Orthodontics

source.title: Biological Variability and Biomedical Innovation in Personalized Orthodontics: A Systematic Review with Narrative Synthesis.
source.excerpt: Personalized orthodontics should remain grounded in comprehensive diagnosis, biologically compatible mechanics, and individualized monitoring. Molecular and computational tools may complement clinical assessment, but routine implementation requires standardized protocols, multicenter validation, and prospective evidence of patient-relevant benefit.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in physical and rehabilitation medicine

source.title: Artificial intelligence in physical and rehabilitation medicine: first update of the living systematic mapping review up to May 31st, 2025.
source.publisher: European journal of physical and rehabilitation medicine
source.excerpt: Literature trends of the update of the living systematic mapping review REHALISE up to May 31, 2025, compared to the first release, suggest a slight and gradual shift toward more clinically oriented applications, though robustness and reproducibility remain critical concerns.

cards.headline: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Implementation in Maternal and Child Health: A Scoping Review

source.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Implementation in Maternal and Child Health: A Scoping Review.
source.excerpt: Further large-scale, long-term implementation studies are needed to evaluate the integration and sustainability of AI in routine maternal and child healthcare practice.

cards.headline: Als sie sie dann zur Welt gebracht hatte, sagte sie: „Mein Herr …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:36
source.excerpt: فلما تمَّ حملها ووضعت مولودها قالت: ربِّ إني وضعتها أنثى لا تصلح للخدمة في «بيت المقدس» -والله أعلم بما وضَعَتْ، وسوف يجعل الله لها شأنًا- وقالت: وليس الذكر الذي أردت للخدمة كالأنثى في ذلك; لأن الذكر أقوى على الخدمة وأقْوَم بها، وإني سمَّيتها مريم، وإني حصَّنتها بك هي وذريَّتها من الشيطان المطرود من رحمتك.

cards.arabic: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَضَعْتُهَآ أُنثَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ ٱلذَّكَرُ كَٱلْأُنثَىٰ ۖ وَإِنِّى سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَإِنِّىٓ أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
cards.translation: Als sie sie dann zur Welt gebracht hatte, sagte sie: „Mein Herr, ich habe ein Mädchen zur Welt gebracht. Und Allah wußte sehr wohl, was sie zur Welt gebracht hatte, und der Knabe ist nicht wie das Mädchen. „Ich habe sie Maryam genannt, und ich stelle sie und ihre Nachkommenschaft unter Deinen Schutz vor dem gesteinigten Satan.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Story of Maryam's Birth: The wife of `Imran mentioned here is the mother of Maryam, and her name is Hannah bint Faqudh. Muhammad bin Ishaq mentioned that Hannah could not have children and that one day, she saw a bird feeding its chick.

cards.headline: Da nahm ihr Herr sie auf gütigste Art an und ließ sie auf schöne Weise heranwachsen und …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:37
source.excerpt: فاستجاب الله دعاءها وقبل منها نَذْرها أحسن قَبول، وتولَّى ابنتها مريم بالرعاية فأنبتها نباتًا حسنًا، ويسَّر الله لها زكريا عليه السلام كافلا فأسكنها في مكان عبادته، وكان كلَّما دخل عليها هذا المكان وجد عندها رزقًا هنيئًا معدّاً قال: يا مريم من أين لكِ هذا الرزق الطيب؟ قالت: هو رزق من عند الله. إن الله -بفضله- يرزق مَن يشاء مِن خلقه بغير حساب.

cards.arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
cards.translation: Da nahm ihr Herr sie auf gütigste Art an und ließ sie auf schöne Weise heranwachsen und gab sie Zakariyya zur Betreuung. Jedesmal, wenn Zakariyya zu ihr in die Zelle trat, fand er bei ihr Versorgung. Er sagte: „O Maryam, woher hast du das? Sie sagte: „Es kommt von Allah; Allah versorgt, wen Er will, ohne zu berechnen.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
